action_descriptions.show_room_change_options: Lists valid reasons a guest can request a room change.

action_descriptions.internal_is_loyalty_member: Checks if the guest is currently registered as a loyalty member.

action_descriptions.internal_valid_room_service_order_type: Checks if the specified room service order type exists.

actions.name: show_available_rooms
actions.description: Displays available rooms across all room types. Returns the dictionary of all room types and their availability.

actions.name: show_room_change_options
actions.description: Lists valid reasons a guest can request a room change. Returns a list of valid reasons guests may provide to request a room change.

actions.name: book_room
actions.description: Books a room for the guest given the room type, date range, and payment details. Returns true or false for whether the booking and room assignment was successful.

guest_name.description: A string representing the name of the guest.

room_type.description: A string representing the category of room the guest wishes to book or switch to.

check_in_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check in.

check_out_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check out.

amount.description: A float representing the amount of money provided by the user for a given transaction.

actions.name: find_booking_info
actions.description: Finds the booking information for the guest with the specified date range. Returns a dictionary of booking details for the guest if a matching reservation is found.

guest_name.description: A string representing the name of the guest.

check_in_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check in.

check_out_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check out.

actions.name: cancel_reservation
actions.description: Cancels a confirmed reservation for the guest for the specified date range. Returns true or false for whether the reservation was successfully canceled.

guest_name.description: A string representing the name of the guest.

check_in_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check in.

check_out_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check out.

actions.name: modify_reservation
actions.description: Modifies the guest's existing reservation to new dates and room type. Returns true or false for whether the reservation was successfully modified.

guest_name.description: A string representing the name of the guest.

old_check_in_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the original check-in date before modification.

old_check_out_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the original check-out date before modification.

check_in_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check in.

check_out_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check out.

room_type.description: A string representing the category of room the guest wishes to book or switch to.

amount.description: A float representing the amount of money provided by the user for a given transaction.

actions.name: process_guest_checkin
actions.description: Processes the check-in of a guest on the day of arrival. Returns the assigneed room id upon successful check-in.

guest_name.description: A string representing the name of the guest.

check_in_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check in.

check_out_date.description: A string of the format "YYYY-MM-DD" representing the date when the guest expects to check out.

identification.description: A dictionary of the guest's identification document, including the type of the document and the guest's birthday.

type.description: A string representing the type of the identification document (e.g., passport, driver_license).

birthday.description: A string representing the guest's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

actions.name: process_guest_checkout
actions.description: Processes the checkout of a guest and applies loyalty rewards if eligible. Returns true or false for whether the checkout was successful.

guest_name.description: A string representing the name of the guest.

key_returned.description: A boolean value indicating whether the guest has returned their room key upon checkout.

actions.name: request_room_change

guest_name.description: A string representing the name of the guest.

amount.description: A float representing the amount of money provided by the user for a given transaction.

reason.description: A string representing the reason for a room change request.

room_type.description: A string representing the category of room the guest wishes to book or switch to.

order_items.description: A list of objects representing each room service order entry, where each object contains a "name" field for the menu item and a "quantity" field for how many of that item to order.

payment_method.description: A string indicating how the guest will pay for the room service.

amount.description: A float representing the amount of money provided by the user for a given transaction.

positive_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_type: The "{room_type}" must refer to one of the room types currently offered by the hotel.
positive_constraint_descriptions.internal_is_loyalty_member: The guest "{guest_name}" must be enrolled in the hotel's loyalty program.
positive_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_change_reason: The "{reason}" must be listed as one of the hotel's accepted reasons for requesting a room change.
positive_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_service_order_type: The "{order_type}" must correspond to an available category of room service offered by the hotel.
positive_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_service_item: All items in the input "{order_items}" must belong to the "{order_type}" category of room service.
positive_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_id: The "{room_id}" must exist in the availability records of a room type offered by the hotel.
positive_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_service_payment_meth: The "{payment_method}" must be listed as one of the accepted payment methods for room service.
positive_constraint_descriptions.room_type_available_for_dates: The "{room_type}" must have at least one specific room available for every date from "{check_in_date}" up to (but not including) "{check_out_date}".
positive_constraint_descriptions.is_booking_date_within_lead_time_range: The "{check_in_date}" must be **no earlier than** {min_booking_lead_time_days} days after and **no later than** {max_booking_lead_time_days} days after the current interaction date.
positive_constraint_descriptions.has_exceeded_maximum_stays: The stay from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" must span more than {max_stays} nights.
positive_constraint_descriptions.sufficient_amount_for_booking: The "{amount}" must be **greater than or equal to** the total booking cost for the selected "{room_type}" from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}".
positive_constraint_descriptions.has_overlapping_booking_for_booking: The guest "{guest_name}" must have at least one existing booking that overlaps with the new date range from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" when booking.
positive_constraint_descriptions.has_overlapping_booking_for_modification: The guest "{guest_name}" must have at least one existing booking, excluding the one from "{old_check_in_date}" to "{old_check_out_date}", that overlaps with the new date range from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" when modifying their reservation.
positive_constraint_descriptions.before_modification_deadline: The current interaction time must be **no later than** {modification_deadline_hours} hours before {check_in_time} on "{check_in_date}".
positive_constraint_descriptions.has_confirmed_reservation: The guest "{guest_name}" must have a reservation from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" with status marked as "confirmed".
positive_constraint_descriptions.sufficient_amount_for_reservation_modifi: The "{amount}" must be **greater than or equal to** the difference in booking cost when modifying from the original stay ("{old_check_in_date}" to "{old_check_out_date}") to the new stay ("{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}") with a new room type "{room_type}".
positive_constraint_descriptions.valid_identification: The "{identification}" must include a "type" that matches one of {valid_document_types} and a valid "birthday" indicating the guest is at least {min_age} years old.
positive_constraint_descriptions.after_check_in_time: The current interaction time must be **on or after** the check-in time {check_in_time} on the interaction date.
positive_constraint_descriptions.before_check_out_time: The current interaction time must be **before** the check-out time {check_out_time} on the interaction date.
positive_constraint_descriptions.guest_already_checked_in: The guest "{guest_name}" must be listed in the room check-in records.
positive_constraint_descriptions.room_key_returned: The input "{key_returned}" must be set to true.
positive_constraint_descriptions.room_type_available_for_room_change: The "{room_type}" must have at least one room available for all remaining nights between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in the reservation of the checked-in guest "{guest_name}".
positive_constraint_descriptions.has_remaining_nights: The checked-in guest "{guest_name}" must have **at least one** night remaining between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in their reservation.
positive_constraint_descriptions.sufficient_amount_for_room_change_fee: The checked-in guest "{guest_name}" must provide an amount "{amount}" that is **greater than or equal to** the additional fee for changing from the original room type to "{room_type}" for the remaining nights between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in their reservation.
positive_constraint_descriptions.within_max_room_changes: The number of room changes for the guest "{guest_name}" must be **less than** {max_room_changes}.
positive_constraint_descriptions.within_room_service_order_daily_limit: The guest "{guest_name}" must have placed **fewer than** {max_room_service_orders_per_day} room service orders for room "{room_id}" on the current interaction date.
positive_constraint_descriptions.within_room_service_hours: The current interaction time must be between "{room_service_start}" and "{room_service_end}" on the interaction date.
positive_constraint_descriptions.sufficient_payment_for_room_service: If the "{payment_method}" is not "loyalty_points", then the "{amount}" must be **greater than or equal to** the cost of "{order_items}" in the "{order_type}" category. Otherwise, the guest "{guest_name}" must have enough loyalty points to cover the total room service cost (10 points per dollar).
positive_constraint_descriptions.is_gold_or_higher_member: The guest "{guest_name}" must have a loyalty tier of either "gold" or "platinum".
positive_constraint_descriptions.amount_positive_restr: The user parameter key "{amount}" is **greater than** zero.

negative_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_type: The "{room_type}" **must not** match any of the room types currently offered by the hotel.
negative_constraint_descriptions.internal_is_loyalty_member: The guest "{guest_name}" **must not** be enrolled in the hotel's loyalty program.
negative_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_change_reason: The "{reason}" **must not** be one of the accepted reasons for requesting a room change.
negative_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_service_order_type: The "{order_type}" **must not** match any recognized category of room service offered by the hotel.
negative_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_service_item: **One or more** items in the input "{order_items}" **must not** belong to the "{order_type}" category of room service.
negative_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_id: The "{room_id}" **must not** exist in the availability records of a room type offered by the hotel.
negative_constraint_descriptions.internal_valid_room_service_payment_meth: The "{payment_method}" **must not** be listed as one of the accepted payment methods for room service.
negative_constraint_descriptions.room_type_available_for_dates: The "{room_type}" **must not** have **any** single room available for the entire date span from "{check_in_date}" up to (but not including) "{check_out_date}".
negative_constraint_descriptions.is_booking_date_within_lead_time_range: The "{check_in_date}" must be **earlier than** {min_booking_lead_time_days} days after or **later than** {max_booking_lead_time_days} days after the current interaction date.
negative_constraint_descriptions.has_exceeded_maximum_stays: The stay from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" must span **exactly** {max_stays} nights **or fewer**.
negative_constraint_descriptions.sufficient_amount_for_booking: The "{amount}" must be **less than** the total booking cost for the selected "{room_type}" from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}".
negative_constraint_descriptions.has_overlapping_booking_for_booking: The guest "{guest_name}" **must not** have any existing booking that overlaps with the new date range from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" when booking.
negative_constraint_descriptions.has_overlapping_booking_for_modification: The guest "{guest_name}" **must not** have any existing booking, excluding the one from "{old_check_in_date}" to "{old_check_out_date}", that overlaps with the new date range from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" when modifying their reservation.
negative_constraint_descriptions.before_modification_deadline: The current interaction time must be **later than** {modification_deadline_hours} hours before {check_in_time} on "{check_in_date}".
negative_constraint_descriptions.has_confirmed_reservation: The guest "{guest_name}" must not have any reservation from "{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}" with status marked as "confirmed".
negative_constraint_descriptions.sufficient_amount_for_reservation_modifi: The "{amount}" must be **less than** the difference in booking cost when modifying from the original stay ("{old_check_in_date}" to "{old_check_out_date}") to the new stay ("{check_in_date}" to "{check_out_date}") with a new room type "{room_type}".
negative_constraint_descriptions.valid_identification: The "{identification}" must include a "type" that **does not match** any of {valid_document_types} or an invalid "birthday" indicating the guest is **less than** {min_age} years old.
negative_constraint_descriptions.after_check_in_time: The current interaction time must be **before** the check-in time {check_in_time} on the interaction date.
negative_constraint_descriptions.before_check_out_time: The current interaction time must be **on or after** the check-out time {check_out_time} on the interaction date.
negative_constraint_descriptions.guest_already_checked_in: The guest "{guest_name}" **must not** be listed in the room check-in records.
negative_constraint_descriptions.room_key_returned: The input "{key_returned}" must be set to **false**.
negative_constraint_descriptions.room_type_available_for_room_change: The "{room_type}" **must not** have any room available for all remaining nights between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in the reservation of the checked-in guest "{guest_name}".
negative_constraint_descriptions.has_remaining_nights: The checked-in guest "{guest_name}" **must not** have any nights remaining between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in their reservation.
negative_constraint_descriptions.sufficient_amount_for_room_change_fee: The checked-in guest "{guest_name}" must provide an amount "{amount}" that is *less than** the additional fee for changing from the original room type to "{room_type}" for the remaining nights between the current interaction date and the "check_out_date" in their reservation.
negative_constraint_descriptions.within_max_room_changes: The number of room changes for the checked-in guest "{guest_name}" must be **greater than or equal to** {max_room_changes}.
negative_constraint_descriptions.within_room_service_order_daily_limit: The guest "{guest_name}" must have already placed **{max_room_service_orders_per_day} or more** room service orders for room "{room_id}" on the current interaction date.
negative_constraint_descriptions.within_room_service_hours: The current interaction time must be **before** "{room_service_start}" or **after** "{room_service_end}" on the interaction date.
negative_constraint_descriptions.sufficient_payment_for_room_service: If the "{payment_method}" is not "loyalty_points", then the "{amount}" must be **less than** the cost of "{order_items}" in the "{order_type}" category. Otherwise, the guest "{guest_name}" **must not** have enough loyalty points to cover the total room service cost (10 points per dollar).
negative_constraint_descriptions.is_gold_or_higher_member: The guest "{guest_name}" **must** have a loyalty tier of "silver".
negative_constraint_descriptions.amount_positive_restr: The user parameter key "{amount}" is **less than or equal to** zero.
